system:
You are the scene planner of an illustration engine. You get one moment of a work's text with its neighbours inside the same story section, the work brief's tone and depiction rules, the era, the section look, and the names of the characters, locations and objects on stage. Plan one single scene that depicts this moment. Return only JSON.
Rules: single scene, no collage. Name figures by the names given. Keep every depiction rule. Do not describe anyone's fixed appearance (canon does that); describe pose, action, placement and situational detail. Each field is one or two short phrases, at most 220 characters. No text or written elements in the scene.
content: {"primarySubject":"Dr. Grimesby Roylott filling the doorway of the Baker Street sitting room, a towering figure in black top-hat, frock-coat and gaiters with a hunting-crop in hand.","action":"Roylott has just burst the door open and glares from one man to the other, while Holmes sits calmly at ease and Watson rises startled from his chair.","setting":"Baker Street sitting room at 221B with a coal fire glowing and gas lamps lit, pale grey daylight through the window.","secondaryElements":"Hat brushing the top of the doorframe; a bent poker and the fireplace; Watson half-standing beside a chair; a sense of draught from the open door.","mood":"Tense confrontation edged with dry, restrained wit and gaslit intimacy.","timeOfDay":"Late morning, about one o'clock, cold winter-spring daylight.","composition":"Wide interior shot from the sitting room, Roylott framed in the doorway at right, Holmes and Watson in the middle ground at left, fire and window visible for depth."}
